The '''Salin Corridor''', originally known as '''Warriors' Trace''' during the time of Xim, was one of the largest [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace trade routes]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Salin Corridor ran along the outside edge of the Rim before cutting towards the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] passing into The [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]] and through [[Novor 23]] before merging with the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] at [[Nwarcol Point]].

==History==
One of the oldest and longest [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], it originated with the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] network of [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacons]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
